decisions.reason: The area-elastic sports floor system was presented on its own page and builds on in-house production know-how, so the investment and visible commitment favour persisting despite the fit with the residential trend direction being weak.
The mobile arena floor needed substantial development and tooling, and disappointing results can be blamed on the temporary pandemic halt of events, so management sticks with it.
This second mobile arena system overlaps with B, which makes it the likelier candidate for consolidation, but the sunk costs and the pandemic explanation for weak demand still argue for keeping it.
Chevron parquet was featured on the home page and sits squarely in the announced trend-led premium flooring direction, so the commitment to it is highest.
The squash court finish is a niche product, but dropping it would admit an error in a visible launch, and the low cost of carrying it lets management keep it.
Oak skirting is a cheap complementary accessory to the sports floors that is easy to keep alongside the systems the firm has committed to.
